result.stdout:
ToPdfNet CLI

Usage:
  topdfnet input.html [-o output.pdf] [options]
  dotnet run --project src/ToPdfNet.Cli -- input.html -o output.pdf

Options:
  -o, --output <path>        Output PDF path. Defaults to input file with .pdf extension.
  --stylesheet <path>        CSS file to apply to the HTML.
  --page-size <value>        a4, letter, or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 8.5inx11in.
  --margin <value>           Equal page margin, for example 0.5in, 12mm, or 36pt.
  --title <value>            PDF title metadata.
  --author <value>           PDF author metadata.
  --subject <value>          PDF subject metadata.
  --keywords <value>         PDF keywords metadata.
  -h, --help                 Show help.
